transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I'm here because... well, at work. I supervise a retail store. Lately, when I try to explain things like the inventory numbers or the schedule for the weekend, I... my words just kind of jump around. I'll be talking about the delivery trucks, and then it's Thursdays, and then the church grill, and then how my boss sounded on the phone. People just stare at me. They can't follow what I'm saying.
Have you been feeling unusually high, excited, or full of energy lately?
No. Not really. I just... I haven't felt like that. Normal, I guess.
Have you been hearing voices when no one else is there?
No... no, I haven't heard anything like that. Just normal sounds.
Do you currently believe that someone is trying to harm you or plot against you?
No. I... no, nobody is plotting against me. I don't know why they would.
Did this problem with your speech start all of a sudden?
No, not sudden. It's... it's been a while. About six months, I think. That's when things started getting jumbled when I'd try to explain things on the sales floor. Just... odd stops.
Have you found yourself caring much less than usual about things or people that used to matter to you?
No... no, I don't think so. I still care about my family. And my job. I haven't really noticed any change like that.
Do you believe you have special powers or a special mission that other people do not have?
No. I... I don't have anything like that. I'm just a regular person.
Have you been speaking much less than you used to?
I don't think so. I... I still talk when I need to. At work and all. I haven't noticed a difference.
Have other people told you that your behavior has seemed very disorganized or strange lately?

I guess... maybe a little at work. Sometimes on the sales floor, I... I catch myself pacing the same aisle. Just straightening the same row of batteries over and over. Or I'll just be standing there with the schedule clipboard in my hand, and... the associates are just waiting for me to tell them what to do. I don't really know why.
Have people told you that your face or voice seems less expressive than it used to?
No... no one's said anything about that. I think I sound the same as I always do.
Do you currently believe that ordinary events or objects have special messages meant specifically for you?
Messages? No... I don't think so. I haven't noticed anything like that. Things are just... what they are.
Have you been seeing things that other people could not see?
No... I don't see anything like that. Just... regular things.
Between these problems, have there been stretches when you felt completely back to your usual self?
I don't know... I'm not really sure what you mean by that. I just... I'm just me, I guess. I haven't really noticed any big changes or stretches like that.
When these problems first began, did they come on very suddenly over a day or two?
Suddenly? I... I don't really remember. It's hard to say when exactly anything started. It just sort of... happened, I suppose.
When this first began, did it start suddenly?
I... I thought you just asked me that. I really couldn't tell you. Like I said, I don't remember it being some overnight thing. It's just hard to remember exactly.
Have there been any weeks during the past six months when your speech and behavior felt completely back to normal?
I... no. I don't think so. I haven't really been paying attention to weeks or... tracking things like that. It's just been the same, mostly.
Before these problems began, was there a single day when you suddenly noticed that something was very wrong?
I... look, you keep asking me the same thing. No. There wasn't one specific day. I don't know what else to tell you about it.
Right before these problems began, did something very stressful happen in your life?
Stressful? I... not really. Just the usual stuff at the store, I guess. Nothing out of the ordinary happened, if that's what you mean. It was just normal.
